عُطْبَةٌ : see عُطْبٌ. ―
-b2- Also A portion of rag by means of which fire is taken: (K:) or a portion of burning cotton (S, A, O) or rag: (S, O:) so in the saying, أَجِدُ رِيحَ عُطْبَةٍ [I perceive the odour of a portion of burning cotton or rag]. (S, A, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
